title: Elara and the Cloud Castle's Secret
logline: A brave girl uses a magical compass and her cleverness to fix a broken Clockwork Dragon, bringing the fading Cloud Castle back to life.

character_bible.name: Elara
character_bible.visual_appearance: Small stature, bright emerald eyes, long braided auburn hair with a few tiny star-shaped beads, fair skin tone.
character_bible.signature_clothing: Soft sky-blue tunic with embroidered silver clouds, forest-green leggings, sturdy brown leather boots.

scenes.title: The Fading Cloud Castle
scenes.narrative_text: Elara noticed the beautiful Cloud Castle, usually so bright and shimmering, was dimming in the sky. Her heart felt a little sad. Suddenly, a glowing Silver Compass appeared, its needle quivering and pointing towards the Whispering Woods. Elara knew a grand adventure awaited her.

scenes.title: Journey Through Whispering Woods
scenes.narrative_text: Following the Silver Compass, Elara ventured into the ancient Whispering Woods. The magical compass glowed warmer with every step, pulling her deeper into the shimmering trees. She knew the legends told of an ancient Clockwork Dragon, the guardian of the Cloud Castle's magic, hidden within these woods.

scenes.title: The Silent Clockwork Dragon
scenes.narrative_text: Deep in a hidden glade, Elara found the magnificent Clockwork Dragon, silent and still. Its gleaming brass scales were dull, and a tiny, vital gear was missing from an open panel on its chest. The dragon's large, gentle eyes looked sad. "Oh, dear dragon," Elara whispered, "the Cloud Castle needs your magic!"

scenes.title: A Spark of Ingenuity
scenes.narrative_text: Elara rummaged through her satchel and found a shining, ornate button she always carried. It was just the right size! With careful hands, she placed the button into the dragon's chest. With a whir and a click, the Clockwork Dragon rumbled to life, its gears turning. It gently scooped Elara onto its back, ready to fly.

scenes.title: The Cloud Castle's Radiance
scenes.narrative_text: Soaring through the sky, the magnificent Clockwork Dragon carried Elara towards the Cloud Castle. Now, it pulsed with brilliant, vibrant light, its magic fully restored! Elara smiled, her heart full of joy, knowing her kindness and cleverness had brought wonder back to the world. The Cloud Castle shone brighter than ever before.
